title: Windows Defender Real-Time Protection
description: Checks if local malware scanning and real-time behavioral protection engines are actively running.

title: Legacy SMBv1 File Sharing Shares

title: SSH Root Password Authentication
description: Verifies if direct, non-key root login authentication is completely disabled in the SSH daemon configurations.
fix_cmd: sudo sed -i 's/^PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sudo systemctl restart sshd
